admitted.product: MyCrypto — self-custody Ethereum wallet interface (send, swap, sign, contract interaction, portfolio dashboard)

evidence.quotedGrantOpening: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software
evidence.verificationMethod: the LICENSE blob was fetched by sha through the git blob API; its recomputed git blob hash equals the sha recorded in the recursive tree of the pinned commit, so the quoted text is the text at this revision

evidence.repositoryShape: single-package application repository: src/ application code, webpack_config/ hand-written build, jest_config/, node-scripts/, spec/, __tests__/, static/
evidence.notes: This is the shipped MyCrypto web wallet, not a scaffold or a demo. It carries its own state layer (redux, redux-saga, redux-persist), a large component library under src/components, and an end-to-end suite driven by testcafe.

evidence.source: package.json at the pinned revision (git blob 783511e29d225f7e4dd8272bbb6137b75a3888f6)

evidence.toolchain: raw webpack with a hand-written configuration; not create-react-app, not ejected from it

evidence.commitVerification: the host reports the pinned commit as carrying a verified signature
evidence.unknownPreserved: The annotated tag itself carries no signature, so it establishes no signer identity. The host's report about the commit signature was recorded as received and not independently verified against a key this unit holds.

candidateJourneys.journey: Add or create an account and land on the portfolio dashboard
Compose and send a transaction, then follow its status
Request assets and inspect the receiving address
Sign a message and verify a signed message
Interact with or deploy a contract from the interface
Manage settings, including importing and exporting the local account store

evidence.knownRisk: Several of these journeys are coupled to an Ethereum JSON-RPC node and to third-party pricing and swap APIs. Whether any journey can be exercised offline is unknown and untested here.
evidence.unknownPreserved: Journeys are read from route definitions and feature directories at the pinned revision. No journey was executed in a browser by this unit, and none is claimed to work.
